sources.title: Reuters: Nvidia accounting is a focus of US SEC investigation
CNBC: Nvidia longest weekly losing streak since 2008
AP: S&P 500 sinks 3.7%, Nasdaq negative for the year

lesson: NVDA +18.94% vs SOX +4.36%，超額 +14.58%，不中。押 SEC 調查＋CEO 空缺會讓 NVDA 續弱，結果 11/23 董事會讓黃仁勳回任，單日 +31%，個股特有風險（idiosyncratic risk）反向消除。教訓：已連跌 7 週、空單擁擠時，一個治理利多就能引爆空單回補（short squeeze），偏空個股要把這種跳空風險算進信心。
